h1: Hop Inn Mae Sot — A Clean-Room Budget Chain Hotel That's the Best Value in Mae Sot
intro: If you're in Mae Sot for cross-border errands, a border crossing, or just an overnight stop before heading on to Umphang, and you want a clean room at a price you don't have to think twice about, the name many people pick is Hop Inn Mae Sot · A budget chain hotel from Thailand's Erawan Group that holds the same standard nationwide — plain, clean rooms with everything you actually need and nothing extra · Real-review score is a high 9.2 from 125 reviews on Trip.com, with cleanliness rated around 9.7 · Rooms start from approx. ฿700/night

body.html: Hop Inn Mae Sot is a budget hotel from the Hop Inn chain, run by Thailand's Erawan Group, which has more than 70 branches across the country · It sits on Asia Road in Mae Sot district, Tak province, close to the Thai-Myanmar border · The chain's selling point is clear: the same standard room in every branch — clean, plain, with just the functions you need at a price you can predict · Cross-border business travellers, drivers stopping for a night, and tourists using Mae Sot as a base before Umphang tend to pick it precisely because they know exactly what they'll get.

Rooms come as a Standard Twin (two single beds) or a Standard Double (one double bed), both around 20 sq.m · Each has AC, a flat-screen TV, a small fridge, and a private bathroom with a hot shower · The most common praise is that rooms are very clean, the bed is comfortable, the AC is cold, and it's quiet enough for a solid night's sleep · The decor is minimal — white-and-yellow brand styling with no clutter · Anyone after a stylish, design-led room may find it plain, but for travellers who just want a clean room to sleep in, this is exactly what Hop Inn does well and consistently.
"Really clean room, comfortable bed, cold AC, good hot-water pressure, cheap price, helpful staff, easy parking — I stay here every time I'm in Mae Sot."

Facilities are budget-focused, covering the essentials · There's free parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, an elevator, and an American buffet-style breakfast you can add on between 6am and 10am · The trade-off to accept up front is that, as a budget hotel, there's no pool, no gym and no big restaurant, and the room soundproofing is only moderate — some reviews mention hearing the next room or the corridor · Breakfast is a simple set rather than a big buffet, so if you want more variety it's better value to eat out in Mae Sot town.

The location is on Asia Road in Mae Sot · It's about a 6-minute drive from Mae Sot Airport (MAQ) and a short drive to Rim Moei Market and the Mae Sot crossing to Myawaddy on the Myanmar side · There are restaurants and convenience stores nearby, and it's close to Wat Thai Wattanaram and Wat Mani Phraison, two in-town sights · It suits self-drivers well thanks to the easy parking · The blended real-review score sits around 9.2 — Trip.com near 9.2 — and TripAdvisor ranks it around #3 of 20 hotels in Mae Sot, which is very high for a budget property.

To be honest, Hop Inn Mae Sot is not for travellers who want a resort feel or a full set of facilities · There's no pool, no gym, the rooms are plain, and soundproofing is only adequate · If you're coming to Mae Sot to fully relax or want the hotel itself to be the highlight of the trip, it won't deliver that · But if what you need is a clean, comfortable, safe room with easy parking at a low, predictable price — Hop Inn Mae Sot does that job very well and is genuinely good value in a border town.

Tips from following the reviews here: ask for a higher floor or a room away from the main corridor if you're worried about noise, since soundproofing is only moderate · If you're just here for one night before moving on, you don't need to pay extra for breakfast — there are several cheap breakfast spots around the hotel · Booking direct through the Hop Inn app sometimes matches platform prices, but it's still worth comparing Agoda and Booking each time, as rates shift a little by season.

honestSummary: Hop Inn Mae Sot is the best-value choice for travellers who want a clean, comfortable, safe room with easy parking at a low, predictable price in Mae Sot · Cleanliness and value are genuine strengths, with very high review scores for a budget hotel — but you have to accept small, plain rooms, no pool or gym, and only moderate soundproofing.
honestChecks: If you want a resort feel or a full set of facilities — there's no pool, gym or big restaurant here → pick a 4-star option like Centara Life in Mae Sot instead.
If you're a light sleeper — soundproofing is only moderate and some reviews hear the next room → ask for a higher floor or a room away from the main corridor, and pack earplugs.
If you plan a multi-night stay with lots of time in the room — the ~20 sq.m rooms are made for sleeping → it's better suited to a 1–2 night stopover than a long stay.
